title: coordkit session state
description: Logical state for one live coordination session. The current bus persists this as a heartbeat record on disk; this schema names the contract so session identity is not just an implementation detail.

sid8.description: Short display prefix for the session.

branch.description: Git branch associated with the session.

task.description: Current task summary shown in the bus.

last_seen.description: Unix epoch seconds of the latest heartbeat.
